sentences.en: I just received a very gracious call from Senator McCain.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚接到了参议员麦凯恩的一个非常亲切的电话。

sentences.en: These events transpired while the senator was still in office.
sentences.zh: 这些事件发生在那位参议员还在任的时候。

sentences.en: The senator charged that I had distorted the data.
sentences.zh: 这位参议员指责说我歪曲了数据。
